chunks: So seek in what God has given you the abode of the Hereafter, and do not forget your share of the world, and do good as God has done good to you, and do not seek corruption in the land. Surely God does not love the corrupters.

key_terms.الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ: The Hereafter / The Abode of the Next World

ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim balance worldly life and the Hereafter according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited by Shia scholars as a cornerstone of the 'balanced life' (al-hayat al-mutawazina), instructs believers to utilize worldly blessings as a means to an end rather than an end in themselves. It highlights the principle of *ihsan* (excellence) in conduct, mirroring divine grace, while warning against *fasad* (corruption) in the earth, a concept deeply explored in Shia exegesis regarding both physical and moral decay.
